say.description: Your line to the player: concise mission-control voice, key numbers first, one or two sentences.

reply_intent.description: Only when classifying the player's typed reply to a pending plan; otherwise null.

due_time_ut.description: The Due Time as UT in seconds when the wait before this sequence is longer than the in-sequence wait cap; otherwise null.

manual.description: True for a stretch the player flies by hand.

mission_time_s.description: Expected total Mission time in seconds, waits between sequences included.

expected_duration_s.description: Seconds of game time from start to report, waits included; the mod stops a script still running at 300% of it.

telemetry_checks.description: What the mod watches while the sequence runs; crossing one sends you an Alert. Units: delta_v_used, delta_v_left and vertical_speed m/s; duration s since the start; apoapsis, periapsis and altitude m; inclination degrees; resource percent of capacity; fuel_margin percent of delta-v left over what the Mission Plan still needs. Config defaults fill any quantity you leave out.

resource.description: The resource name for quantity resource, e.g. ElectricCharge; otherwise empty.

direction.description: Crossed when the quantity goes above or below the threshold.

custom_script.description: True when the script is written from scratch instead of from Building Blocks.

custom_script_reason.description: For a Custom Script, one short sentence on why no Building Block fits; otherwise empty.

due_time_ut.description: The earliest UT in seconds the sequence may start, when a wait longer than the in-sequence wait cap comes first; otherwise null.

window_closes_ut.description: UT in seconds after which the planned window is missed, if the sequence depends on one; otherwise null.

late_window_dv.description: Delta-v in m/s of the next window if the planned one is missed; null when there is none.

script.description: The complete Mission Script in kerboscript; empty for a manual stretch.

manual.description: True when the player flies this stretch by hand (docking, EVA science, or when they say they will fly it): the script is then empty.

eva_science.description: Science only a Kerbal on EVA can do next, as an instruction to the player; empty if none is needed.

verdict.description: abort recommends the player Abort; you never abort yourself.

follow_up_threshold.description: With carry_on: one more threshold for the same check, in its units, for one more Alert; otherwise null.
